4.message:
fix(1.8): resolve modern material names via XMaterial in advancement items

Material.getMaterial(id) only matches the exact bukkit enum name, so modern
config names (CRAFTING_TABLE/GUNPOWDER/ENDER_EYE) logged "invalid item type"
and skipped the advancement on legacy versions where the enum is named
differently (WORKBENCH/SULPHUR/EYE_OF_ENDER). Fall back to XMaterial.matchXMaterial
+ MaterialCompat.safe so those names resolve to their 1.8 equivalents.
4.author: intisy (Finn Birich)
